meta.subset: first PER_CLASS val files of each synset, sorted by filename
meta.definition: gamma2(k,tau) = mean_images mean_pixels ||v_theta(x_tau) - (B_k x1 - (e_k-s_k) x0)||^2; x_tau = H_tau x1 + sigma_tau x0; x0 ~ eps_for(name, k); CFG guidance from config sampler_kw; class embedding = own class; REAL G (eff_si=None)

precision.note: matmul TF32 (v rel. err ~3e-3 vs fp32); classes without a 'precision' field were measured in strict fp32 before the 2026-09-04 switch

meta.tau_grid: sampler per-stage schedule (PixelFlowScheduler, ode_steps_per_stage, shift); keys str(round(tau,6))
